name: Tira Pompadour
original_name: ティラ・ポンパドール
source:
Occupation: Young Lady
Hobbies: Taking a stroll though the Garden

The daughter of the lord of the town. She is quite sheltered, since her father never allowed her to leave the house. She takes out her frustrations by hunting monsters.

What could possibly be the secret behind this ordinary girl's ability to fight monsters?
